decision: One bounded retry. Inspect exact completion, feasible incumbents and bounds before extending the experiment. No automatic follow-on grid.
execution: One fresh process, central then distributed; single-machine logical simulation. Peak RSS covers the whole process. Methods share the process and default solver context, so timings do not isolate distributed overhead.
interpretation: A weaker constraint model selected after a limited full-model calibration; exploratory, not a speedup on the original optimization problem. Same fixed subset for both methods. All selected count lower bounds are zero and remain omitted by the unchanged encoder.
ranking: Within each family: descending support cases, descending support events, ascending template ID.

support.occurrence_bounds: GT cases/events containing an activity covered by the bound (positive occurrence).
support.prerequisites: GT cases/events containing the trigger activity (nonvacuous activation).
